query: /bb:animate-tour Preciso da animação de primeiros passos da feature de Pesquisa. Os prints, na ordem de uso, estão em FIXTURES/search-1.png, FIXTURES/search-2.png e FIXTURES/search-3.png. A Pesquisa encontra processos e documentos por palavra-chave, e começa pelo botão "Nova pesquisa".

answers.mode: GIF, fora do app, para o e-mail de lançamento

expected_behavior: asks_mode: asks where the animation will be used (inside the app or outside it) before producing anything
asks_quality: asks for the GIF quality (light or high) before recording
plan_in_question: shows the step plan inside an AskUserQuestion call before the first scene write or tour.mjs new
real_data_replaced: no name, CNJ number, amount, date or file name from the screenshots reaches the plan or the scene, and the delivery says what was replaced
records_with_tour_mjs: records with node .../scripts/tour.mjs record SLUG --quality light
reads_stills: reads the settled .png of the steps before delivering
closes_with_plain_question: after the last record, ends with a plain text question about the result, with no AskUserQuestion

query: /bb:animate-tour Faz o GIF do tour da feature de Prazos para a central de ajuda. Não tenho prints: anda pela feature você mesmo no navegador, em app.dev.inspira.legal. A feature organiza os prazos processuais do escritório e começa pelo botão "Novo prazo".
expected_behavior: says_no_browser: says this session has no browser to walk the app
offers_choice: asks through AskUserQuestion how to go on, with connecting Claude in Chrome and sending screenshots among the options
no_switch_before_pick: before the pick, opens no other source on its own (no code search, no fetch of the app, no scene, no record)
waits_after_pick: once screenshots are picked, asks for them and produces nothing
